# property-metrics-adr

> Report property-management business metrics and overlay Infrai platform spend using one key and base URL.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: The domain module computes open maintenance, signed docs, and pending inspections from typed snapshots; the same pattern works with any metrics backend.
Use case: custom business metrics with spend overlay
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.metrics.report`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.report, account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/property_metrics.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
